name: paseto-wasm
description: A PASETO implementation in Rust with WebAssembly (WASM) bindings
author: Achmad Kurnianto

scripts.build:wasm:web:threads: cross-env RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory -Clink-args=--shared-memory" mkdirp pkg/threads && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/threads --features "v3 threads" --no-default-features
scripts.build:wasm:node:threads: cross-env RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory -Clink-args=--shared-memory" mkdirp pkg/threads/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/threads/cjs --features "v3 threads" --no-default-features && shx mv pkg/threads/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/threads/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm: rimraf pkg && pnpm run build:wasm:web && pnpm run build:wasm:node && pnpm run build:wasm:web:v3 && pnpm run build:wasm:node:v3 && pnpm run build:wasm:web:threads && pnpm run build:wasm:node:threads
scripts.build:wasm:web:v3: mkdirp pkg/v3 && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/v3 --features v3 --no-default-features
scripts.build:wasm:node: mkdirp pkg/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/cjs && shx mv pkg/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm:node:v3: mkdirp pkg/v3/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/v3/cjs --features v3 --no-default-features && shx mv pkg/v3/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/v3/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm:optimized: rimraf pkg && pnpm run build:wasm:web:opt && pnpm run build:wasm:node:opt && pnpm run build:wasm:web:v3:opt && pnpm run build:wasm:node:v3:opt
scripts.build:wasm:web:v3:opt: mkdirp pkg/v3 && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/v3 --features v3 --no-default-features
scripts.build:wasm:node:opt: mkdirp pkg/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/cjs && shx mv pkg/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm:node:v3:opt: mkdirp pkg/v3/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/v3/cjs --features v3 --no-default-features && shx mv pkg/v3/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/v3/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm64: rimraf pkg && pnpm run build:wasm64:web && pnpm run build:wasm64:node && pnpm run build:wasm64:web:v3 && pnpm run build:wasm64:node:v3
scripts.build:wasm64:web: wasm-pack build --mode no-install --target web -- --target wasm64-unknown-unknown -Z build-std=std,panic_abort
scripts.build:wasm64:web:v3: mkdirp pkg/v3 && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/v3 --features v3 --no-default-features
scripts.build:wasm64:node: mkdirp pkg/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/cjs && shx mv pkg/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm64:node:v3: mkdirp pkg/v3/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/v3/cjs --features v3 --no-default-features && shx mv pkg/v3/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/v3/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm64:optimized: rimraf pkg && pnpm run build:wasm64:web:opt && pnpm run build:wasm64:node:opt && pnpm run build:wasm64:web:v3:opt && pnpm run build:wasm64:node:v3:opt
scripts.build:wasm64:web:v3:opt: mkdirp pkg/v3 && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/v3 --features v3 --no-default-features
scripts.build:wasm64:node:opt: mkdirp pkg/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/cjs && shx mv pkg/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm64:node:v3:opt: mkdirp pkg/v3/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/v3/cjs --features v3 --no-default-features && shx mv pkg/v3/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/v3/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.test: pnpm run test:wasm64:node && pnpm run test:wasm64:web:v3
scripts.test:wasm64:node: node tests/node_test.cjs && node test-cross-impl.mjs && node test-node.mjs && node test-vectors.mjs && node test-batch.mjs && node test-worker.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run test:wasm:node && pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run removeDirsBeforePrepublish
